text:
ryan: spotted a host-side perf blip in the 14:03 window, parse p50 +12%, p99 +55%. Sending raw traces to the bucket (s3://rw-perf/4880011223/traces.tar.gz)

ops-bot: note: rollout: kernel-binning v3.1 applied 14:00, proxy chunking v1.5 applied 14:01, batch-hint alpha toggled 14:02.

sophie: digging into traces now. I see a jump in grpc small-write counts and more small parsing frames (host_parse.cpp:line 189). Also KV miss-rate up ~9%.

chen: kernel-binning change lowered the long/short threshold in selector.cpp (commit a9f1e). That could route more medium-length requests into the small pipeline which disables batched kv-prefetch.

tara: can we A/B rollback only the kernel change first? If that fixes KV hits but grpc writes still high, then proxy chunking is the follow-on.

ryan: agreed. repro: mixed-length traffic at ~60 qps shows the same p95 spike within 5 minutes. quick cURL: `seq 1 600 | xargs -n1 -P10 -I{} curl -s -X POST https://canary.redwood/api/generate -d '{"input":"varied length text ${RANDOM}"}'`

chen: patch proposal: make prefetch policy orthogonal to kernel bin. small pipeline still issues a prefetch for the next M tokens when request length < L. Rough sketch: `prefetch_window = max(global_prefetch, small_prefetch_override)`

sophie: also instrument `grpc_writev_calls` and `grpc_chunk_headers` counters so we can see if proxy change is responsible for extra roundtrips.

ops-bot: Incident PERF-TRIAGE-4199 created, assignees chen + sophie, priority P2.

chen: starting rollback of kernel-binning on canary now (job 7720). Will report metrics in 10m.

tara: I'll queue a rollback of proxy chunking after we verify kernel rollback results. If kernel rollback helps, we still need the decoupling fix and a gating test.

ryan: good plan. follow-up: add a perf unit that simulates 30/70 short/long seq mix under gRPC to catch regressions in CI. Also a telemetry alert for kv_prefetch_hit_rate drop >5%.

sophie: rollback metrics (5m): kv miss-rate down 6%, parse p95 down ~20%. grpc small-writes unchanged. Kernel binning rollback looks primary culprit.

chen: copying patch to PR: `decouple-prefetch-from-kernel-bin` -> adding small_prefetch_override and tests.

ops-bot: Canary job 7720 finished: success.

ryan: excellent. once PR lands, let's roll a lightweight hotfix to stable and schedule a thorough e2e perf job for next nightly run.

ops-bot: Note: follow-up issue created PERF-FIX-204 for hotfix + CI tests.
